text: と　つよく　ねんじた　ほうが　いい

structure.jp: と　つよく　ねんじた

patterns.name: 〜たほうがいい
patterns.span: ねんじた　ほうが　いい
patterns.explanation: A past-form verb plus ほうがいい gives advice: 'you had better do it'. ねんじた　ほうが　いい = 'you'd better wish for it'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: と　つよく　ねんじた
patterns.explanation: と points back at the words just said, here the かちたいッ！ of the line before, as the thing being thought. と　ねんじた = 'wished "I want to win!"'.

patterns.name: 〜く
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い to く lets a describing word say how an action is done. つよく　ねんじた = 'wished strongly'.
